brief:
Israeli forces killed eight people across Gaza on Friday and issued fresh expulsion orders to residents, Middle East Eye reported. The strikes occurred ahead of the first anniversary of a ceasefire between Israel and Gaza. Families were forced to evacuate their homes following the military directives.

The killings and displacement orders marked a new escalation of tensions as the region approached the ceasefire's anniversary date.

title: Israeli strikes kill eight in Gaza as families flee homes
